original.statement: The 0.16 upgrade guide lists a pre-upgrade check: before upgrading, operators must confirm that no `v1alpha1` resources are used anywhere in their infrastructure (manifests, tooling, etc.).

decision.reason: The 0.16 upgrade guide's "Pre Upgrade checks" section [ev-d9673d74f883] tells operators to make sure they are not using any `v1alpha1` resources anywhere in their infrastructure, and to check this by inspecting their manifests and tooling. That is a step the operator must take before upgrading, so the migration family with migration-required fits. The name remove-v1alpha1-resources uses the text's own key words (v1alpha1, resources). One caveat: "remove" is my paraphrase of the text's "not using". The evidence does not say what fails if this step is skipped, but the consequence is not one of the aspects I was asked to check.
